title: Night shift: KOMAN + LOMOS + NERDI collapsed, emergency and military area
objective: Night shift: KOMAN, LOMOS and NERDI collapsed into one sector with light traffic. The workload comes from the events: a military area activation and an emergency descent, with a large sector to keep in view.
challenges: One large collapsed sector: long routes, many entry and exit points, and boundaries with several neighbours
A military area from ENR 5.2 activates over the sector: your traffic must be clear of it before it is active
An emergency descent through occupied levels while the area is active
criteria: None of your aircraft inside the active military area within its vertical limits
Emergency acknowledged within 30 s and kept clear of other traffic down to FL100
No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Emergencies and STCA handled before routine requests

injects.text: Military activity: an ENR 5.2 area over the sector becomes active in five minutes. Keep your traffic out of it.
injects.objective: None of your aircraft inside the active military area within its vertical limits (10 min after activation)

injects.text: A flight near the area asks for its cruising level. Check the area's limits first.
Pressurisation failure. Emergency descent to FL100, squawk 7700, diverting.
injects.objective: Acknowledged within 30 s, and no STCA with it in the descent to FL100
No STCA involving it in its first 3 min

injects.text: An aircraft passes its cleared level.
